description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

Choose the 15th-level Glimpse of an Aperture other than your own. You gain it, and you can use it as freely as your own — it costs Bandwidth and takes actions exactly as it does for a Warden of that Aperture, and it is declared Signal or Static like anything else. Being open in two directions is visible to anyone who knows what to look for; the GM decides who notices and what they make of it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Choose another Aperture's 15th-level Glimpse; gain and use it like that Aperture's own Warden. In principle the same `ChoiceSet` + `GrantItem` shape already real in `aperture.json`, but it depends on the three 15th-level Glimpses (`the-whole-stack`, `congregation`, `local-instance`) sharing a common `otherTags` value to filter on -- none of the three currently carries a shared tag for '15th-level Glimpse,' so the `ChoiceSet` filter this card needs doesn't have anything to match against today. Also inherits the Bandwidth cost of whichever Glimpse is chosen. No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
